tools.name: app_info
tools.title: About PoortLink
tools.description: Return a brief description of the PoortLink / TukConnect platform, its brands and its capabilities.

tools.name: list_loading_zones
tools.title: List loading zones
tools.description: List active taxi loading zones (pickup areas) with location, radius, marshal status, and operating hours.

limit.description: Maximum number of zones to return. Default 50.

tools.name: list_drive_to_own_programs
tools.title: List Drive-to-Own programs
tools.description: List the active Drive-to-Own program tiers with eligibility thresholds, timelines and graduation bonuses.

tools.name: get_zone_availability
tools.title: Zone availability (real-time)
tools.description: Real-time hailing / booking availability for a loading zone: waiting drivers in the queue, next-in-line vehicle, live driver count within the zone radius, and estimated wait based on recent departures. Requires sign-in.

zone_id.description: Loading zone UUID. Provide this OR zone_name.

zone_name.description: Zone name (case-insensitive contains match). Ignored if zone_id is given.

tools.name: list_my_fleet_vehicles
tools.title: My fleet vehicles (owner)
tools.description: List fleet vehicles owned by the signed-in user. Only rows the caller can see under RLS are returned — non-owners get an empty list.

tools.name: get_my_driver_profile
tools.title: My driver profile & reputation
tools.description: Return the signed-in driver's profile row plus reputation score, compliance score, and infringement count. Requires a driver record for the caller.
